exposure: timing of AAP 2022 newborn hyperbilirubinemia guideline publication (before vs. after)
outcome: clinical outcomes (length of stay, readmissions, duration of phototherapy)
cohort: The study included over 22,000 newborns born at ≥35 weeks' gestation across a network of 8 hospitals.
finding: The publication of the updated AAP 2022 hyperbilirubinemia guidelines was associated with a significant reduction in phototherapy utilization (47% decrease) and serum bilirubin measurements (23% decrease) without an increase in readmissions receiving phototherapy.
country: N/A (implied USA due to 'American Academy of Pediatrics' but not explicitly stated for study location)
cross-section timing: N/A (retrospective comparison of two periods: January 2022 to June 2023)
